user.title: Outdoor conditions
user.description: Pick where the outdoor readings come from. Either a sensor or a weather entity works; a physical thermometer near the flat is more accurate than a forecast.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: These rooms were found in your areas. Untick anything you do not want scored -- you can edit the individual sensors later under Configure.

data.rain_guard: Cap the score while it rains

data_description.comfort_band: How far from the target still counts as comfortable, so small differences do not push the score around.
data_description.humidity_weight: How much the humidity comparison counts. 0 turns humidity off; damp rooms raise this automatically.
data_description.settle_minutes: Indoor sensors keep falling after the windows shut. Waiting gives an honest cooldown figure.
data_description.min_session_minutes: Anything shorter is treated as a glance out of the window, not as airing.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Pick a room to edit, or add a new one.

room.title: Edit room
room.description: Editing {name}. Clearing both the temperature and the window entity removes the room.

discover.title: New rooms
discover.description: These areas are not configured yet.

abort.no_new_rooms: Every area with a thermometer or a window contact is already configured.
